financials_interim.notes: COMPANY (standalone) basis -- no segmental note is disclosed for the Company basis, so operating_profit (67,235,268) was derived the same way as Group (Net Rental Income + Other Income and Gains + Change in FV of Investment Properties - Selling&Distribution - Admin Expenses); this reconciles to PBT after deducting Finance Cost (50,923,046 vs disclosed 50,923,046, ~Re.1 rounding). 6M FY2026 (Jan-Jun 2026) interim, FYE 31 Dec. 'operating_profit' = Net Rental Income + Other Income and Gains + Change in FV of Investment Properties - Selling&Distribution - Admin Expenses, which reconciles exactly to the 'Segment Operating Profit' subtotal disclosed in the Operating Segment Information note (Group: 149,068,350 for 6M26 vs 121,162,272 for 6M25) and to PBT after deducting Finance Cost. No separate 'finance income' line is disclosed in the P&L, so finance_income is left blank. 'gross_profit'/'cost_of_sales' map to the P&L's own Net Rental Income and Direct Expenses lines -- these match the CEO letter's stated 'Gross Profit of Rs.203mn' figure exactly. tax_expense/minority_interest are both nil per the P&L (no income tax charge, no NCI attribution this period; NCI balance in the Statement of Changes in Equity had already gone to zero by 1 Jan 2026). IMPORTANT: the 6M25 comparative PBT (Rs49.7mn Group) includes a Rs181.325mn fair value gain on investment property revaluation which was almost entirely offset by a Rs159.2mn negative swing in 'Other Income and Gains' in the same period (net one-off benefit ~Rs22.2mn) -- 6M26 has neither a revaluation gain nor a large other-income swing (Other Income and Gains was a small +Rs7.8mn). This means the 45% YoY PBT growth is driven almost entirely by organic Net Rental Income growth (Rs152.6mn -> Rs203.4mn, +33%), not a repeat of the prior year's one-off items.

interim_updates.company_name: COLOMBO LAND AND DEVELOPMENT COMPANY PLC
interim_updates.note_text: Colombo Land & Development Company PLC (CLND) Group revenue rose 20% YoY to Rs.266.8mn for H1 FY2026 (six months ended 30 June 2026), driven primarily by a 43% rise in rental income and 97% occupancy (vs 94% in the comparative period) across its Liberty Plaza, Peoples Park and Gas Land properties. Net Rental Income (the filing's gross-profit line) grew 33% to Rs.203.4mn from Rs.152.6mn. Car park income was roughly flat overall (+1%): Liberty Plaza car park revenue rose 20%, Gas Land car park fell 6%, and Peoples Park was flat. Group PBT rose 45% to Rs.71.9mn from Rs.49.7mn, but this comparison is distorted by a large offsetting swing in the prior-year comparative: 6M25 PBT included a Rs.181.3mn fair value gain on investment property revaluation that was almost fully offset by a Rs.159.2mn negative swing booked through 'Other Income and Gains' (net one-off benefit of roughly Rs.22.2mn), whereas 6M26 had no revaluation gain and only a small Rs.7.8mn positive Other Income. Stripping out that one-off, the 45% PBT growth is essentially all organic, from the 33% Net Rental Income improvement outrunning a 13% rise in Finance Cost (Rs.71.5mn to Rs.77.2mn), which the CEO's letter attributes to the sharp rise in market interest rates. By segment, Property Leasing & Services PBT rose from Rs.51.3mn to Rs.74.8mn, while the small Plantation segment's operating loss widened from Rs.1.66mn to Rs.2.93mn (immaterial to the Group total).
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for CLND -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. finance_income left blank (no separate finance income line disclosed in the P&L -- only 'Other Income and Gains' and 'Change in value of Investment Properties', which are captured within operating_profit). Company-basis trade_receivables/cash figures are from the Company column of the Statement of Financial Position; Company-basis Inventories are nil (no inventories at the standalone entity level, only at Group).
interim_updates.takeaway: Headline PBT growth of 44-45% overstates like-for-like improvement: the prior-year comparative period benefited from a Rs.181.3mn investment-property revaluation gain that was mostly offset by a large negative swing in Other Income, while this year has neither item. The real driver is a genuine 33% increase in Net Rental Income on higher occupancy (97% vs 94%) and higher rentals, partly eroded by a 13% rise in finance costs as interest rates climbed.
operational_highlights: Group revenue Rs.266.8mn for H1 FY2026, up 20% YoY from Rs.221.9mn
Net Rental Income (gross profit) up 33% YoY to Rs.203.4mn from Rs.152.6mn, on 97% occupancy vs 94% prior year
Rental income up 43% YoY per the CEO's letter; Liberty Plaza car park revenue up 20%, Gas Land car park down 6%, Peoples Park flat
Finance costs up 13% YoY to Rs.77.2mn (Group) amid rising market interest rates
Group PBT Rs.71.9mn, up 45% YoY from Rs.49.7mn; Company (standalone) PBT Rs.50.9mn, down from Rs.191.4mn in 6M25 (which included the one-off Rs.181.3mn investment property revaluation gain)
Property Leasing & Services segment PBT Rs.74.8mn (6M26) vs Rs.51.3mn (6M25); Plantation segment loss widened to Rs.2.93mn from Rs.1.66mn
key_drivers: Occupancy improvement (97% vs 94%) and rental rate increases across Liberty Plaza, Peoples Park and Gas Land properties, per the CEO's letter

6M25 comparative PBT was inflated by a Rs.181.3mn one-off investment property fair value gain, largely offset by a Rs.159.2mn negative swing in Other Income and Gains in the same period -- neither recurs in 6M26
Rising market interest rates pushed Group finance costs up 13% YoY (Rs.71.5mn to Rs.77.2mn)
Property Leasing & Services remains the only Group segment with positive operating profit; the Plantation segment is immaterial and loss-making
